meta.note: SYNTHETIC — no real personal facts; every name, number and place is invented. Same schema as the private O2 set (queries[].kind/expected, vault-relative paths, the part before '#' is compared) plus two CI-only fields: 'required' (this positive must hit on its own, SPEC F2-2) and kind 'first-not' (the first hit's file name must not be 'first_not', SPEC F2-3). Positives: 3 daily-only, 1 Duzeltmeler-only, 4 knowledge/concepts-only, 2 both. Negatives are measured and printed, never gated (SPEC R7).
